prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1183; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in significant injuries to them. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Kindly provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy that applies to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, vehicle data, witness statements, claim notes, adjuster logs, and any recorded statements. Please treat this letter as formal notice of our representation and of our client's claim. We expect a prompt written response confirming receipt, the policy information requested, and the name of the adjuster assigned to this file.
